te: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Electorate of Saxony are defeated by the Swedes at the Battle of Chemnitz, ending t…
dz: 三十年战争：神圣罗马帝国和萨克森选帝侯的军队在开姆尼茨战役中被瑞典人击败，结束了撒克逊军队在战争剩余时间的军事效力，并允许瑞典人进军波西米亚。
de: Thirty Years' War: Forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Electorate of Saxony are defeated by the Swedes at the Battle of Chemnitz, ending the military effectiveness of the Saxon army for the rest of the war and allowing the Swedes to advance into Bohemia.

de: In England, the Yorkists under Edward IV defeat the Lancastrians under the Earl of Warwick at the Battle of Barnet; the Earl is killed and Edward resumes the throne.

de: Tokhtamysh–Timur war: At the Battle of the Terek River, Timur defeats the army of the Golden Horde, beginning the khanate's permanent military decline.

de: Otto II, Co-Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, marries Byzantine princess Theophanu. She is crowned empress by Pope John XIII in Rome the same day.

dz: 在他与波西米亚的基督教徒杜布拉夫卡(英语:Christian Doubravka (Bohimia))通婚后,波兰人的异教统治者米斯兹克一世皈依了基督教,这一事件被认为是波兰国家的建立.
de: Following his marriage to the Christian Doubravka of Bohemia, the pagan ruler of the Polans, Mieszko I, converts to Christianity, an event considered to be the founding of the Polish state.

de: Vitellius, commanding Rhine-based armies, defeats Roman emperor Otho in the First Battle of Bedriacum to take power over Rome.
